ada: Quick idea — handle cross-region spikes by locality-aware queuing + tenant opt-in for burst failover. Keep local-first for residency, but allow controlled overflow to secondary regions for latency/availability.

mike: Do you mean per-tenant flags? That gets messy for enterprise contracts/data sovereignty.

ada: Yup, per-tenant policy. Two types: "no-cross-region" (strict), "burst-allowed" (can overflow under capacity pressure). Default to strict unless customer opts in.

sophia: What about KV cache consistency? If we overflow to a different region we can't read local-only caches.

ada: We won't migrate KV ownership; overflow will use cold path with read-through. Cache TTLs and prefix caching continue to be local-only. Overflow is best-effort to keep latency, not to preserve cached warm state.

juan: Can we express this as routing policy + queue token? E.g. route->local queue; if queue depth > X then route to overflow pool if tenant policy allows.

liam: +1. We should expose operator knobs: queue_depth_threshold, backpressure_window_ms, prefer_local_ratio.

infra-bot: Deploy plan checklist generated for locality-burst: 1) config flags 2) canary 3) telemetry hooks 4) runbook update

sophia: Also need a safe handshake: overflow requests must tag origin region + tenant policy and return a provenance header so we don't accidentally persist region-specific artifacts.

ada: Agreed. Proposed header: X-Orig-Region, X-Tenant-Residency-Mode, X-Overflow-Reason

mike: Logging/metrics: measure overflow_count, overflow_latency_delta, and overflow_cache_miss_ratio. Alert if overflow_rate > 0.5 for >5m for strict tenants.

juan: Edge case: what if overflow region can't call back to local data stores due to egress rules? Need a preflight check in router.

liam: We should add a "dry-run" mode that simulates overflow routing in prod and emits telemetry without actually routing.

ada: Plan: write RFC addendum with config model + runtime contract + sample runbook. I'll draft by EOD, can people review tomorrow?

mike: I can review. Also let's add legal to notify for customers with strict residency.

sophia: I'll add a short test harness to simulate TTL/cold-path perf.

ada: Thanks — putting action items in a follow-up thread. :thumbsup:
